QuestInfo.name: Make a Pink Song Pyun Set!
QuestInfo.0: You can't celebrate Moon Festival without making a Song Pyun Gift Set. Now comes the third challenge! It's time to make a Pink Song Pyun Set. Click on the Moon Festival Event Notifier on the left side of your screen to get some Pink Song Pyuns to make a gift set.
QuestInfo.1: You are making a Pink Song Pyun gift set now. Remember! You can't get any Pink Song Pyuns from the monsters that are 11 or more levels below you and 21 or more levels higher than you.
QuestInfo.2: You've completed a Pink Song Pyun Set! You can try again after 5 minutes. You can move onto the next level and make a Golden Song Pyun Set once you successfully complete 7 Mugwort Song Pyun Sets.
